document_notes: The page contains the continuation of entry PIR² A 1322 (Atrius Clonius) at the top, which is highly relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus as it lists three governorships (Cappadocia, Syria maior, Hispania citerior) as Legatus Aug. pr. pr.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly identified as Legatus Aug. pr. pr. of Cappadocia, Syria maior, and Hispania citerior.
